name: Historical Fiction
description: Declarative historical-fiction preset. Period constraint and social texture; no living-author imitation.
purpose: Let period institutions, material life, and speech limits shape what characters can do.
writing_goals: Anchor scenes in period-possible action and technology
Show class, gender, faith, or law as live constraints
Avoid modern slang and modern problem-solving shortcuts
constraints: Do not imitate a living author
Use abstract narrative style, not a named living voice
Characters with unexplained modern ethics and no friction
Anachronistic tech or medicine used as a convenience
checklist: Dates, titles, and institutions stay internally consistent
Travel and communication delays are respected
Social penalties for transgression remain in force
No unexplained anachronism in tools or speech

pacing_tendency.value: social maneuver and delayed news; travel and letters take time

description_tendency.value: material culture, labor, clothing, food, and public ritual
